headline: DMD Advocates advises New Delhi Centre for Sight on multi-State Strategic Expansion
sum: DMD Advocates acted as legal counsel to New Delhi Centre for Sight (NDCFS), one of India’s leading eye care hospital chains, in connection with its strategic expansion across India through a series of acquisitions, business transfers and…
detail: DMD Advocates acted as legal counsel to New Delhi Centre for Sight (NDCFS), one of India’s leading eye care hospital chains, in connection with its strategic expansion across India through a series of acquisitions, business transfers and strategic partnership transactions. The transactions comprised: the acquisition of Saraswati Nethralaya, Haryana; the acquisition of equity and collaboration with Mehta Eye Clinic Private Limited, Maharashtra; the acquisition of Jhamwar Eye Hospital, Maharashtra; a strategic joint venture collaboration and investment transaction with Ratan Jyoti Netralaya, Madhya Pradesh; a strategic joint venture collaboration and investment transaction with Paliwal Eye…
